about: Engine fixes found by research rounds (public companies, no portfolio data). Read by fundamental_engine/learning.py: fixes per company researched should fall over time if the engine is learning. kind: engine_bug (wrong result from the engine), missing_input (a pattern the engine could not express; now an evidenced input), classification, data_gap (data the collectors did not bring).

fixes.finding: 5-for-1 split of December 2025 read as 72.8% share issuance
fixes.fix: issuer split tag (StockholdersEquityNoteStockSplitConversionRatio1) read as a dated corporate action; weighted-average shares restated for splits

fixes.finding: analysis TypeError when a weighted-average share count was missing
no consensus in the structured feeds
fixes.fix: consensus read from public pages (web__consensus-estimates__annual.json), dated at retrieval

fixes.finding: 3-for-1 split of 2 April 2026 placed after the 31 March count, which the 10-Q had already restated; the real 3x step left unresolved
fixes.fix: dataqa: a split up to 92 days after a count filed after the split belongs to the step into that count; a dated split counts only for a step it explains

fixes.finding: an evidenced 'structural' cycle reading was silently ignored when the model card had normalized the cycle from the history
fixes.fix: the analyst's evidenced treatment governs, with a warning and a material issue for the reviewer; the forecast reports the routed method

fixes.finding: debt 17.1bn instead of 10.6bn: LongTermDebt (the total) plus its current portion
fixes.fix: a noncurrent line under another tag (LongTermLoansPayable) that adds up with the current portion to the LongTermDebt tag settles the tag as the total (dataqa and the annual table)

fixes.finding: deposit and securitization funding of the credit book, whose interest is in cost of revenue, was subtracted again as debt
fixes.fix: inputs.forecast.operating_funding (evidenced), with a warning when reinvestment is not measured net of it

fixes.finding: a $258m licence sale in revenue and a $698m acquired-R&D charge started the forecast at -33% margin on a falling revenue base
fixes.fix: inputs.forecast.nonrecurring: evidenced one-offs of listed kinds removed from fiscal years, TTM and year to date; recurring costs cannot be removed

fixes.finding: royalty financing obligation ($427m) outside the bridge; its interest made the term loan look 20%
what_must_be_true reported 'not reachable' when one end of the search was unfunded or invalid
fixes.fix: bisection on validity moves the end to the edge of the valid domain

fixes.finding: foreign filer: half-year results only in a 6-K press release, TTM 10 months stale
fixes.fix: H1 statements loaded through the evidence bundle from the 6-K exhibit (primary document)

fixes.finding: 2-for-1 split of 3.9.2026 came after the last filed count (28.7.2026): the post-split quote was divided by the pre-split count, doubling value per share ($121 shown instead of about $60; 'attractive' instead of 'expensive'). MNST (3-for-1) had the same error in the large-cap run.
fixes.fix: IBKR corporate actions loaded as dated splits; a split after a count published before it restates the count; the listing's market cap off by a split factor makes the share count a conflict (blocks) when no dated split explains it

fixes.finding: current maturities ($1.6bn) missed: the current-portion tag LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligationsCurrent was not mapped
fixes.fix: tag mapped; the filer's total including current maturities settles the scope of the long-term debt tag
